en: Welcome to Artazon Gym! Brassius's gym test is out in the town: find the Sunflora hiding among Artazon's flowers.
They stand perfectly still, like sculptures. Find all three, then come through to Brassius's garden.
Congratulations on the Grass Badge! Levincia's gym is up the road north, and Cortondo's is west of Mesagoza.
Brassius's Grass types can't stand fire, ice, flying, poison or bug moves. Plenty to choose from!
You beat Brassius! He's probably sculpting your victory as we speak.
